headline: US imposes sanctions on 13 tied to Iran weapons procurement
summary: The US Treasury and State departments sanctioned 13 individuals and entities, including some based in Russia, China, Hong Kong and Pakistan, for helping Iran procure weapons and components.
why: US sanctions can cut targeted parties off from the dollar system and US banks, which affects trade and financing links with Iran and its suppliers.
